exposure: fetal transposition of the great arteries
cohort: 17 women with a prenatal diagnosis of fetal transposition of the great arteries at Virgen del Rocío University Hospital between 2015 and 2021
finding: A full-term delivery policy in fetuses diagnosed with transposition of the great arteries was associated with a high rate of full-term births (94.1%) and a low cesarean delivery rate (17.6%).
